correctness.rationale: Polyhedral isotonic projection locally has feasible connected-block averaging derivatives; the converse face-realization uses acyclic contracted quotients, strict block-level order and positive tight-edge normal multipliers. The coarea identity reduces every block-averager BV norm to binary cuts. A fully enumerated integer-exact Python/NumPy certificate covers 10,52,272,1424,7456 realizable faces and respectively 140,3224,69088,1455328,30524864 cut comparisons, with attained equality witnesses. Separately, explicit whole-top-row pooling proves the general lower bound; coordinate monotonicity, translation covariance and connectivity prove upper 3k-2. The finite computational certificate was replayed and the infinite-width claim follows algebraically. No claim for exact k>=7.

value.rationale: This is a natural first multi-cycle product-order isotonic least-squares setting. The exact first-five ladder profile identifies the smallest failure of graph BV nonexpansivity and the first gain exceeding two; an explicit all-width lower witness and matching linear-order upper bound demonstrate that Euclidean contraction fails to control graph-variation sensitivity by any width-independent constant. This structural instability is relevant to stability analysis of shape-restricted grid denoising; not a mere restatement of a known diamond or tree case.
